create_fake_uma_dataset: create a fake UMA dataset with oc20 and omol train and val splits in a temp directory
create_fake_dataset: create a fake dataset from a FakeDatasetConfig with specified system size and energy statistics
create_fake_benchmark_dataset: create a fake benchmark dataset using BENCHMARK_DATASET_SPECS for model evaluation testing
generate_structures: generate random atomic structures with configurable system size range and periodic boundary conditions
FakeDatasetConfig: configure a fake dataset with name, split, system count, energy stats, and file paths
